title: Inordinate
summary: INOR'DINATE, adjective [Latin inordinatus; in and ordo, order.] Irregular; disorderly; excessive; immoderate; not limited to rules prescribed, or to usual bounds; as an inordinate love of the world; i

inlines.v: INOR'DINATE, adjective [Latin inordinatus; in and ordo, order.] Irregular; disorderly; excessive; immoderate; not limited to rules prescribed, or to usual bounds; as an inordinate love of the world; inordinate desire of fame.
